# Data Pipeline Checklist: Guy Sports Team Capture and Usage Analysis

**Purpose**: Review the requirements quality for the capture, processing, rendering, and validation boundaries of the Guy Sports data pipeline.

**Created**: 2026-08-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required capture responsibilities fully specified for seasonal raw data collection, including source selection, page traversal, timestamping, and additive storage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, FR-002, FR-003, FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Are the required processing outputs explicitly defined for player ownership counts and manager change summaries, with a clear link to the presentation layer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-010, FR-011, FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 Are the reader-facing presentation requirements sufficiently detailed for local and GitHub Pages viewing, including the static HTML requirement and the no-live-data dependency? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, FR-022, FR-023]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec clearly define the expected repository layout for season-scoped raw data, processed data, and rendered output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, FR-014, Data Model]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the distinction between raw capture data, processed derived data, and the generated HTML render unambiguous to readers and implementers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, FR-015, FR-022, FR-023]
- [x] CHK006 Is the phrase “latest committed processed data” sufficiently precise for the implementation and review process, especially in relation to local experimental changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, FR-023]
- [x] CHK007 Are the storage boundaries and permissions clear for raw historical data versus local disposable working data? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, FR-023, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 Is the requirement for “human-browsable” storage defined well enough to support design decisions without leaving multiple incompatible interpretations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the historical-preservation requirements align consistently across capture, processing, and reporting without contradicting the local reset rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, FR-020, FR-021, FR-022, FR-023]
- [x] CHK010 Do the requirements for no-live-data presentation align with the rule allowing only a narrow live smoke test under exceptional circumstances? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, FR-024, FR-025, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 Are the raw-data append-only rule and the committed-output preservation rule consistent with the project’s historical data and traceability goals? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, FR-004, FR-022, FR-023, Constitution]
- [x] CHK012 Are the seasonal grouping assumptions consistent across the data model, storage layout, and the season-level reporting requirements? [Consistency, Data Model, Spec §FR-013, FR-014, §Season]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are the success criteria measurable for historical retention, change detection, and aggregate correctness without relying on implementation detail? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, SC-003, SC-004, SC-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are the presentation outcomes measurable for static HTML output, local review, and GitHub Pages-style hosting without live data access? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-016, SC-006]
- [x] CHK015 Does the spec define objective criteria for a valid test or review of the HTML output and summary content without describing a specific framework or code path? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 4, SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are alternate scenario requirements defined for missing manager records, unchanged snapshots, malformed data, page-count changes, and duplicate capture records? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are recovery or rollback expectations defined for raw data retention and for committed rendered outputs when local experimental changes are discarded? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, FR-022, FR-023]
- [x] CHK018 Are exception-flow requirements defined for retrieval failures, partial page failures, malformed YAML content, and an unavailable live source when a smoke test is explicitly requested? [Coverage, Spec §FR-024, FR-025]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are requirements explicit about what happens when a manager is absent from a season page during a capture without causing historical loss or silent data corruption? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements explicit about how unchanged team snapshots remain auditable while still avoiding false duplicate change events? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-020, FR-008]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements explicit about the treatment of malformed or incomplete historical snapshots and whether they are skipped, quarantined, or rejected? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional and Operational Boundaries

- [x] CHK022 Are the operational assumptions for offline validation clearly separated from the exceptional live smoke-test path so the default route stays deterministic and safe? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-024, FR-025, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK023 Are the repo-friendly, static-hosted presentation requirements clear enough to support review in GitHub Pages without relying on a running backend or live API calls? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-016, SC-006]
- [x] CHK024 Are the assumptions about season layout, append-only storage, and future extension documented well enough to avoid accidental schema drift or cross-season contamination? [Dependencies & Assumptions, Data Model, Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK025 Are the dependencies on upstream data sources and season page structure explicitly described, including the boundary that they are the source of truth for capture but not for presentation queries? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-005, FR-006, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Is the assumption that only Guy Sports is in scope for the initial implementation clearly separated from future DreamTeamFC expansion? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-025, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK027 Are the implementation assumptions regarding file structure, YAML format, and static HTML output documented without hiding the need for a future exception approval if the design changes materially? [Assumptions, Plan, Research]
